Your routine

Reset
Start each work block with your Day 1 checks, cushion and lumbar support in place.
Work
Screen at eye level, elbows at 90°. Use the 20/20 rule to catch slouching early.
Move
Stand every 60–90 minutes and run through your Day 5 desk stretches.
